I love this app but I am forced to give it a low review to get your development team to pay attention. 
This has been going on for over a year, all iPhone users are having trouble with the comment section, and you aren’t doing anything to fix it because you flagged it as a UI bug and it’s “inconvenience” since the app doesn’t crash. 
But if you want people to be happy with your app, fix this issue with the iPhones, maybe make a workaround that works with iPhones because it gets tiring quickly to use reply comments to scroll or to use the website to scroll through the comments. Please, for the love of god, I don’t know what else to give you to get you to pay attention. 
And you better not reply with an automated reply because that would defeat the entire purpose of this review. I’ve had this app for YEARS and the problem roused only a year or two ago. I don’t want to leave it because I love the stories, but the UI trouble is too much for a major feature meant to connect users. 

Fix this please.

reviews.title: Censorship
reviews.text: I have been a longtime Wattpad user. I’ve been reading books and stories through this site since I was 13 and I’m now 23 going on 24. To say I’m utterly disappointed is an understatement. The addition of ads and needing a subscription for no ads was a first strike for me. I continued to use the site and app nonetheless because I wanted to continue supporting small and new authors and their work. I appreciate all forms of art and creativity, and despite the ungodly amount of ads I still appreciated the fact that Wattpad became a site that made it easy for new and upcoming authors to publish and share their work to the public. I even decided to pay the subscription to read without the nuisance of ads and pop ups and continued to read and use the app. Regarding this new development in your terms of service, this new form of censorship that you’re forcing upon writers and readers is absurd. You already have the option for mature and 18+ content, the fact you feel the need to police and censor content that 18+ adult readers consume is ridiculous, not to mention the fact that you’ve already began removing these books from user’s libraries and pulling them from the site is insane. I feel sorry for the artists and authors, and I hope the site founders and devs are pleased with the loss of thousands of users and loss of revenue from subscription holders. I have already cancelled my subscription and will be deleting my account.

reviews.title: App is super buggy. - Website in general is great.
reviews.text:
I love wattpad. I’ve been writing on it for over 10 years, the general idea of the website and what it allows you to do is amazing, the desktop version is really good as well, but my app on my phone or tablet is extremely glitchy and buggy. At least for me. 

Example - Edits to books and profile don’t save. Polls from chapter 1 appear in chapter 7 which I haven’t added or even published yet, pictures appear on desktop version, but not on mobile…I can’t even log in most of the time.

reviews.title: Pricing
reviews.text: I use to use Wattpad all the time. If anything this has always been one of my favourite book apps. This coin thing though is ridiculous I get things can’t always stay free I’d be more than happy to pay a monthly subscription to read however many books like most things do but the coins are ridiculous pricing. For roughly 5 chapters of one book is the cost of 1 actual real published authors books I don’t get how this pricing is justified I’d rather have to watch more ads than pay the prices that are being asked.

reviews.title: Fixes. ASAP.
reviews.text: I’ve been using Wattpad for 13 odd years now, first found it through FB! Now all I can say is I’m ashamed of how much of a money grabbing pile of rubbish this app has become. It’s shameful. The communities on Wattpad used to be so engaging and fun, the authors just regular people posting because it was a hobby they enjoyed! Now you can’t even copy and paste your own work!! I’ve seen a lot happen and change through the years and I left when my own work was deleted for no reason. Now I can’t say I’m happy to be using the app again, but I’ll support the authors I enjoy reading wherever they go. This company just needs to revert back, and stop trying to scam people so they can pay their own authors.

reviews.title: It used to be better
reviews.text:
I’ve been on wattpad for years now, since I was in my mid teens. It was good for finding new writers and aspiring authors but during the past couple of years it’s become glitchy and frustrating to use. I keep getting logged out at random times when I go into the app, books I’ve archived are reappearing in my library with no updates so no reason for them to be there (making my library a mess) and adding/finding new books to read has become unpractical because books I add to my library end up shuffled and in no order that makes sense and the only books I get recommended on my home page don’t match genres I’m reading on the app at all. 

It used to be a really good hub for communities to be made and writers to make themselves known and now it’s barely practical 🥲
